content.text: Not too long ago, an underestimated St Mirren team defeated Celtic in a semi-final and then went on to beat Hearts at Hampden, clinching the 2013 League Cup.

St Mirren, competing in the Scottish Premiership, played to a goalless draw against League 1 champions Arbroath away from home and forfeited the bonus point after being defeated in the penalty shootout of the Premier Sports Cup.
